newsitem.title: USA: House veteran Hamilton to retire.
newsitem.headline: House veteran Hamilton to retire.

text.p: Representative Lee Hamilton of Indiana, a member of the House since 1965 and the senior Democrat on the International Relations Committee, announced Monday he will not seek re-election in 1998.
Hamilton, 65, was one of the House's most respected voices on foreign policy and in the past has been mentioned as a possible candidate for the post of secretary of state.

He was chairman of what was then named the Foreign Affairs Committee prior to the Republican takeover of the House in the 1994 elections and had long served as chairman of a subcommittee overseeing Middle East policy.
He was also co-chairman of a joint congressional committee investigating the Iran-Contra affair during President Ronald Reagan's administration.
